The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original

delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses # TERMS & CONDITIONS **For Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Haematology Analyser Machine** 1. The bidder shall provide a live demonstration of the Haematology Analyser, if required, during technical evaluation. 2. Rates should be quoted for a good-quality Haematology Analyser strictly as per the technical specificati ons mentioned in the tender document. 3. The bidder's firm/company must have its registered office located in South Gujarat, within the geographi cal area from Navsari to Surat, Gujarat. Valid documentary proof of the registered office must be submitte d along with the quotation. 4. The bidder must submit a valid GST registration certificate, PAN card and relevant business registration documents along with the quotation. 5. The bidder shall submit an authorization certificate from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), w herever applicable. 6. The bidder must submit a declaration stating that the firm/company is not blacklisted or debarred by an y Government Department, Government Institution or Public Sector Undertaking. 7. The supplied machine must strictly conform to the prescribed technical specifications. No alternative sp ecifications or inferior-quality equipment will be accepted. 8. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, GST, transportation, loading, unloading, installation and commissioning charges. 9. The supplier shall provide free installation, demonstration and necessary operational training to the con cerned laboratory staff. 10. The supplier shall provide a minimum **two-year comprehensive warranty** from the date of successf ul installation and commissioning, including spare parts, labour and service charges. 11. The supplier shall provide a **three-year Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CMC/AMC) afte

r completion of the warranty period**. It shall include preventive maintenance, breakdown services, labour charges, necessary spare parts and technical support without any additional cost to the institution. 12. The supplier must ensure prompt after-sales service. Service complaints should preferably be attende d to within 24–48 hours of reporting. 13. The supplier shall provide all necessary operating manuals, technical documents, calibration details an d quality-control procedures along with the machine. 14. The supplier shall ensure the availability of compatible reagents, controls, calibrators and other essenti al consumables required for the smooth functioning of the machine. 15. Any damage, shortage or breakage during transportation shall be the sole responsibility of the supplier and shall be replaced without any additional cost. 16. No advance payment shall be made. Payment shall be processed only after successful delivery, install ation, commissioning, inspection and satisfactory performance of the machine. 17. The bidder must submit a written undertaking confirming the availability of comprehensive AMC/CMC s ervices for three years after completion of the warranty period. 18. The supplier shall provide necessary calibration and quality-control certificates/documents, wherever a pplicable, and demonstrate satisfactory functioning of the equipment before final acceptance. 19. The bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements for the supply of med ical diagnostic equipment in India. 20. All disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent court at Navsari, Gujarat. 21. The bill shall be processed only after complete inspection, successful installation, commissioning and s atisfactory observation of the machine by the concerned authority. 22. Earnest money deposit of 5100/- to be given in the name of ADHYAKSHSHREE ROGI KALYAN SAMITI SD H KOTAGE .
